limitations: Pad dimensions and package geometry are transcribed from the TI DDC0006A datasheet example; independently review solder mask, paste, courtyard, assembly, and fabrication rules before production.
The symbol pin labels follow the TI TPS3710 pinout: 1 GND, 2 VDD, 3 GND, 4 SENSE, 5 GND, 6 OUT.
